notes:
- New: your Hanami profile ✿ Click your name in the top bar
- Trophies from your Steam achievements: rarer = better (bronze, silver, gold), and 100% of a game earns a platinum
- A PS5-style level, recently earned trophies, and a trophy cabinet with every game's progress
- Pick a game in the cabinet to see all its trophies, how rare they are and when you earned them

- Welcome to the Hanami beta ✿
- Settings → Send feedback (also in the M menu): saves a report with Hanami's logs to your Downloads, with logins and keys blanked out
- Hanami now keeps its own log, so problems can actually be tracked down

- War for Cybertron has its real key art in the Store, and on its tile in Games and Library
- Store card text stays readable on bright artwork

- Smoother home screen: moving between games no longer stutters (Hanami's work per frame cut by more than half)
- Petals fall at a silky 60 fps
- Patch notes now pop up right here on the home screen after an update, with Don't show again
- Settings → Show patch notes after updates turns the popup back on

- When a new Hanami comes out while it's open, the home screen shows it: F2 to update!
- After updating, the patch notes open in a new What's new tab
- Settings → Patch notes shows every version's notes
- The in-game menu's button row is back, with Close game: press it twice to quit and return to Hanami's home screen

- Fixed: your controller could steer Hanami (and launch games) while you played a game in front of it
- Notifications that pop up during a game no longer take button presses
- On laptops with two graphics chips, Store games now run on the fast one (NVIDIA/AMD)

- Hanami goes to sleep while you play, so games get the whole GPU
- Home screen and Control Center are much lighter, with the same look
- New: Settings → Lighter effects, for older graphics cards
- WFC updates keep the gamertag you set in the game

- Updates now install right inside Hanami — no extra windows
- If an update ever can't start, Hanami goes back to the version that works
- Recomp updates show a big progress popup with what's new

- Hanami updates itself from GitHub when it opens
- Recomps update from the Store, with progress in Downloads
